results.title: Serializable values that can be passed from the Server to ...
results.snippet: Props passed from the Server to Client Components need to be serializable. This means that values such as functions, Dates, etc, cannot be passed directly to Client Components. In fact, Date, Set, Map, especially Promise are seriarizable.
